name: diagram-studio
description: Design diagrams with Claude: Azure architectures in Microsoft Azure Architecture Center style with the official icons (/diagram-studio:azure), and business diagrams such as operating models, swimlanes, roadmaps, value chains, 2x2s and layered architectures (/diagram-studio:business). Compare concepts on a live preview board, refine by conversation, then export PowerPoint, draw.io, SVG, PNG or PDF.
